command: (cd /Users/carter/dev/approval-md && backlog task create "Escalation raises scrutiny on side effects only: read.* stays autonomous under a tripped floor" -d "2026-09-06/07: once the loop floor tripped, every hook call was routed to the human, read.* included, so a session that could not get an answer could not even grep. APRV-280 made reads not COUNT toward the floor, and the floor's refusal text says so, but a tripped floor still ROUTES them. A read cannot cause the harm the floor exists to bound (SPEC §10.2: only side effects accrue), so routing it buys no safety and costs a nine-minute wait per read plus a phone message per read. Carter asked on 2026-09-07 for reads to stay autonomous." --ac "Under a tripped loop floor (session or actor scope) a tool call whose classes are all read.* resolves by policy, not by loop safety: no request is raised, no message is sent, and the hook's reason names the floor as bypassed for a read; tests/cli-hook.test.ts covers a tripped floor followed by a read (allowed at once) and a side-effecting call (routed)" --ac "A mixed call (read.* plus a side-effecting class) is still routed as one question; the read classes inside it are neither counted nor separately raised" --ac "approval status and the refusal text say reads are exempt from routing as well as from counting; docs/claude-code-hook.md updated; CHANGELOG entry; SPEC 10.2 amendment text (the floor bounds side effects and routes side effects) written into the task notes for hand application" -l hook,daemon --priority high 2>&1 | tail -2)
